title: School Lunch
description: School lunch menus, day by day, from Skolmaten or Mateo.

schools.title: Schools
schools.description: The schools to show. Pick the provider (where the school publishes its menu), then the municipality and the school.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Where the school's menu is published: skolmaten.se or Mateo. If you can't find the school in one, try the other.

short_name.title: Short Name
short_name.description: Optional. Shown instead of the school's name, for example a child's name. Leave empty to show the school's name.

days_ahead.title: Days To Show
days_ahead.description: How many school days to show, counted from the first day shown (weekends are skipped). Days without a menu are left out. Skolmaten publishes only the current week, so with Skolmaten you see at most the days left of this week; Mateo publishes further ahead.

enum_titles: After lunch, start from the next school day
after_lunch.title: After Lunch
after_lunch.description: What to do with today's menu once lunch is over.

switch_time.title: Lunch Is Over At
switch_time.description: The time when lunch counts as over. Blank means 13:00.

show_header.title: Show Header
show_header.description: Show or hide the module's title.
